page_title: Customize your macOS menu bar · Dynamic Menu Bar

sources.entry: Dynamic Menu Bar - Changes the color and shape of the macOS menu bar with live screen-matched colors, gradients, a music visualizer and per-app profiles.

summary.name: Dynamic Menu Bar
summary.one_liner: Dynamic Menu Bar is a paid macOS app that changes the color and shape of the Mac's menu bar, including live screen-matched colors, gradients, and a music visualizer.
use_cases: Making the macOS menu bar match the colors of the screen beneath it
Giving each app its own menu bar look
Showing a music-reactive visualizer in the menu bar
Rounding display corners or using a pill-shaped menu bar
Trying a macOS menu bar customizer before buying
summary.what_it_does: Dynamic Menu Bar changes the appearance of the macOS menu bar. It can mirror the screen beneath it in real time, hold a solid color or gradient, and react to music with a visualizer that the page says runs up to 120 Hz. It can round the display's corners, apply a pill shape, and keep separate looks for different apps through per-app profiles. It can also give a window a full-screen look without a separate Space. The page lists a keyboard shortcuts feature and says multi-display support is coming soon. It is distributed as a direct download with a 7-day free trial and one-time license pricing from $6.99 for one Mac.
notable: Live screen-matched menu bar colors plus gradients and hue drift
Music visualizer reacting to audio, up to 120 Hz
Per-app profiles for different menu bar looks
Free 7-day trial with all features, then one-time license
caveats: Requires macOS 26 Tahoe or later on an Apple silicon Mac
Paid after a 7-day free trial; one-time license priced $6.99 for 1 Mac, $9.99 for 2, $14.99 for up to 5
Multi-display support is listed as coming soon
